modules.name: Complaint Life Cycle
modules.description: Handles a complaint from the resident raising it through checking, assignment, fixing and resident approval or reopening.

requirements.title: Raise complaint with category, issue and photos
requirements.description: A resident picks a category, writes the issue and can optionally add photos to raise a complaint.

requirements.title: Create complaint number and set Waiting for Check
requirements.description: The system creates a complaint number when a complaint is raised and sets its status to Waiting for Check.

requirements.title: Society Manager checks complaint genuineness
requirements.description: The Society Manager checks each complaint. A non-genuine complaint is set to Rejected with a reason, the resident is notified and the flow ends. A genuine complaint moves on to routing.

requirements.title: Route genuine complaints by category
requirements.description: For Builder responsibility, Raghuvir Admin assigns an Assigned Person. For Society responsibility, the Society Manager assigns a society vendor.

requirements.title: Track status from Assigned to Work Started
requirements.description: After assignment, the complaint status moves to Assigned and then Work Started.

requirements.title: Mark complaint Fixed with remark and photo
requirements.description: The Assigned Person marks the complaint Fixed and adds a remark and a photo.

requirements.title: Wait for resident approval and notify resident
requirements.description: After Fixed, the status becomes Waiting for Resident Approval and the resident is notified.

requirements.title: Resident approves or reopens complaint
requirements.description: If the resident approves, the complaint is Closed and removed from the resident's list. If the resident reopens with a reason, it goes back to Work Started.

requirements.title: Escalate unchecked complaints after 24 hours
requirements.description: A complaint not checked within 24 hours is escalated to Raghuvir Admin.

requirements.title: Alert on complaints not fixed within time limit
requirements.description: If a complaint is not fixed within the category time limit, a senior or Raghuvir Admin is alerted.

requirements.title: Send reminders when resident does not respond
requirements.description: If the resident does not respond after Fixed, reminders are sent on set days (for example day 2 and day 5), which Raghuvir Admin sets. After the last reminder the Society Manager is alerted.

requirements.title: Send repeatedly reopened complaints to Raghuvir Admin
requirements.description: A complaint reopened more than 2 times goes to Raghuvir Admin.

rules.title: Only the raising resident can close a complaint
rules.description: Only the resident who raised a complaint can close it. There is no auto-close, and the complaint closes only when the resident approves.

rules.title: Society Manager filters non-genuine complaints first
rules.description: The Society Manager filters out non-genuine complaints before any routing or assignment.

rules.title: Society Manager's own complaint checked by someone else
rules.description: A complaint raised by the Society Manager is checked by another member with the Check complaints permission, or by Raghuvir Admin.
